 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The word **"Refuggee"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is **"Refugee"**.
 
• Meaning of "Refuggee": The incorrect word does not exist in English, so it has no meaning. (इस शब्द का कोई अर्थ नहीं है।)
 
 
• **Example:** There is no example since "Refuggee" is not a valid word.
 
 
 
• Meaning of "Refugee": A person who has been forced to leave their country due to war, persecution, or natural disaster. (शरणार्थी)
 
 
• **Example:** Thousands of refugees crossed the border to seek safety in neighboring countries.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct spelling is "Refugee" and the word "Refuggee" is incorrect.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Probably** (शायद): Used to express uncertainty or likelihood.

 
 
• **Example:** It will probably rain later today.
 
 
 
• **Honestly** (ईमानदारी से): In a truthful or sincere manner.
 
 
• **Example:** Honestly, I didn’t expect the movie to be so entertaining.
 
 
 
• **Violent** (हिंसक): Using or involving physical force intended to hurt, damage, or kill.
 
 
• **Example:** The protests turned violent after the police intervened.
